Documentation Overview

Welcome to the Neutrino Electron documentation! This comprehensive guide will help you understand, configure, and customize your privacy-first static site boilerplate.

Quick Start

  1. Installation - Get up and running quickly
  2. Configuration - Customize your site settings
  3. Content Management - Learn how to manage your content
  4. Themes - Customize the appearance of your site

What is Neutrino Electron?

Neutrino Electron is a modern, privacy-first static site boilerplate built with:

  • Eleventy (11ty) - Static site generator
  • Decap CMS - Headless content management
  • Sass/SCSS - Advanced styling capabilities
  • Nunjucks - Powerful templating engine
  • SEO System - Built-in search engine optimization

Key Features

  • 🔒 Privacy-First - No tracking, no analytics, no external dependencies
  • ⚡ Fast Performance - Optimized for speed and efficiency
  • 🎨 Flexible Theming - Customizable design system
  • 📱 Responsive Design - Works on all devices
  • 🔍 SEO Optimized - Built-in meta tags and social sharing
  • 📝 Content Management - Easy-to-use CMS interface
  • 🛠️ Developer Friendly - Modern tooling and workflows

Documentation Structure

Our documentation is organized into logical sections:

  • Getting Started - Installation and basic setup
  • Configuration - Site settings and customization
  • Content Management - Working with content and CMS
  • Development - Advanced development topics
  • Themes - Design system and styling
  • Deployment - Publishing your site
  • API Reference - Technical documentation
  • Troubleshooting - Common issues and solutions
  • SEO System - Search engine optimization features

Getting Help

If you need assistance:

  1. Check the Troubleshooting section
  2. Review the API Reference for technical details
  3. Explore the Configuration options
  4. Consult the Development guide

Contributing

Neutrino Electron is an open-source project. Contributions are welcome! Please see our Development section for guidelines on contributing to the project.
